decisions.reason: The accelerator is publicly promoted on the home page and builds on existing advisory capabilities, but it is less central than the plant products, so escalation yields a moderate but still low drop probability.
The bio-based binder has dedicated page commitment and likely high R&D sunk costs, but it is less central to decentralized recycling, so escalation supports keeping with a somewhat higher drop risk.

The infectious waste plant is close to the established offer, highly visible on the home page, and central to decentralized waste treatment, so sunk costs and public commitment make dropping unlikely.

The mobile recycling plant directly embodies the firm's announced decentralized recycling direction, was featured on the home page, and has high sunk investment, so escalation strongly favors keeping.
